research_centers.name: McMurdo Station
research_centers.description: Largest Antarctic research station operated by the US Antarctic Program. Located on Ross Island.

research_centers.name: Scott Base
research_centers.description: New Zealand's Antarctic research station on Ross Island, near McMurdo Station.

research_centers.name: Mawson Station
research_centers.description: Australian research station in Mac. Robertson Land. One of the oldest continuously operating stations.

research_centers.name: Davis Station
research_centers.description: Australian research station in the Vestfold Hills, Princess Elizabeth Land.

research_centers.name: Casey Station
research_centers.description: Australian research station in the Windmill Islands, Budd Coast.

research_centers.name: Halley VI Research Station
research_centers.description: British Antarctic Survey station on the Brunt Ice Shelf. Modular and relocatable.

research_centers.name: Syowa Station
research_centers.description: Japanese Antarctic research station on East Ongul Island, Lützow-Holm Bay.

research_centers.name: Neumayer Station III
research_centers.description: German research station on the Ekström Ice Shelf, Atka Bay.

research_centers.name: Bharati Station
research_centers.description: Indian research station on the Larsemann Hills, Princesse Elizabeth Land. Operational since 2012.

research_centers.name: Maitri Station
research_centers.description: Indian research station in Schirmacher Oasis, Queen Maud Land. Operational since 1989.

research_centers.name: Concordia Station
research_centers.description: Franco-Italian station at Dome C on the Antarctic Plateau. One of the most remote stations.

research_centers.name: Princess Elisabeth Station
research_centers.description: Zero-emission Antarctic research station in Dronning Maud Land.

research_centers.name: Jang Bogo Station
research_centers.description: South Korean research station near Terra Nova Bay, Ross Sea.

research_centers.name: Zhongshan Station
research_centers.description: Chinese research station on the Larsemann Hills, East Antarctica.

research_centers.name: Villa Las Estrellas
research_centers.description: Chilean civilian settlement and research station on King George Island, South Shetland Islands.
